name: Seed Junky Pre-Roll | Malibu
description: Malibu is a hybrid strain packed with sweet flavor that transitions into a complex fuel driven flavor, highlighted by hints of tropical candy. Malibu gives a balanced head and body high, leaving you slightly spaced out with a goofy grin.
